name: Riftglass Razor Shard
description: A fractured shard with impossibly thin killing edges.
specialEffects: Used in daggers, portal-cut implements, and unstable precision work.

steps: Refine raw stock for Riftglass Razor Shard under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Riftglass Refinery protocol before storage.
